title: ChatGPT Pro 200 ka Codex limit 29 October ke baad badal raha hai - kya karein
content:
Agar aap ChatGPT Pro two hundred use karte ho, toh is Thursday ke baad aapka Codex allowance kam ho sakta hai.
Pehle background samjho.
OpenAI ne ChatGPT Pro ko teen plans mein baant diya hai. Pro hundred, Pro two hundred, aur Pro five hundred dollars per month.
Pro two hundred ab naye subscribers ke liye phir se open hai.
But new subscriptions get a lower usage allowance than before.
Ab important part.
Jinke paas twenty two September se twenty nine September ke beech active Pro two hundred tha, unhe purana allowance milta rahega.
Lekin sirf TWENTY NINE OCTOBER TAK.
Uske baad subscription lower allowance pe chala jayega. Price same rahega, two hundred dollars.
OpenAI ke Tibo Sottiaux ne September mein X pe likha tha. Plus is one X, Pro hundred is five X, aur Pro two hundred is ten X.
Existing users ko kuch time ke liye twenty X milta rahega.
So in simple terms, the multiplier goes from TWENTY X TO TEN X.
Toh ab kya karein? Teen kaam.
Ek. Settings mein USAGE SECTION kholo, aur dekho aap har hafte kitna allowance use karte ho.
Pro plans pe Work aur Codex mein abhi five hour wala limit nahi hai, but weekly allowance hai.
Do. Har kaam ke liye sabse bada model mat chalao. Chhote edits ke liye halka model kaafi hai.
Save the heavy model for the hard problems.
Teen. Agar allowance kam pade, toh Help Center ke hisaab se kuch features ke liye credits khareed sakte ho.
Ya phir socho ki aapko sach mein kaunsa plan chahiye.
Maan lo aap freelancer ho aur roz Codex se client ka code likhte ho.
Agar aap apna usage pehle se track karoge, toh deadline wale din limit aapko surprise nahi karegi.
Mera take simple hai. AI tools ki pricing ab har mahine badalti hai. Plan karo, aur KISI EK TOOL PE poori tarah depend mat raho.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
